source_title: Polymarket Deepens Partnership With Chainlink as Official Oracle for High-Speed Up/Down Markets and Launches Gold and Silver Trading - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Building on the more than $11 billion in trading volume already powered by Chainlink, Polymarket is now expanding its 15-minute markets to commodities, equities, and forex.
NEW YORK , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Polymarket , the world's global prediction market, has deepened its strategic partnership with Chainlink , the standard for onchain finance, as its official oracle for high-speed up/down markets. 15-minute gold and silver markets are now live on Polymarket as it expands its offerings beyond crypto and into the world's most widely traded assets across equities, commodities, and forex.
This expands Polymarket's existing partnership with Chainlink, which has driven more than $11 billion in trading volume around 5- and 15-minute crypto price markets. Built on Chainlink's industry-standard decentralized oracle infrastructure, which has proven secure and reliable through extreme market volatility, blockchain network congestion, and major cloud infrastructure outages, Chainlink provides Polymarket with high-speed, accurate pricing at any hour through Data Streams and the Chainlink Runtime Environment .
"Polymarket traders are some of the most connected in the world. With Chainlink 24/7, they can now take positions in a growing number of equity, commodity, and FX markets at all times. Chainlink gives us the reliable, high-speed data to launch new markets at scale, and gives our users the confidence that they will resolve accurately." â Neal Kumar, Chief Legal Officer, Polymarket
Polymarket's market makers and algo traders can now receive the same low-latency Chainlink Data Streams powering these markets through self-serve access , equipping them with the accurate data they need to price new markets the moment they go live. With its market participant ecosystem ready, Polymarket can now launch new offerings at scale as it expands across asset classes.
"Prediction markets have become one of the most powerful ways to forecast the outcomes of global events, and Polymarket is a leading platform in the category. We're excited to see Polymarket expand into traditional assets with Chainlink as its official oracle infrastructure. Our high-speed pricing data enables Polymarket to resolve these markets with the accuracy and efficiency its users expect. " â Johann Eid, Chief Business Officer, Chainlink Labs
Polymarket is the world's global prediction market platform, where participants trade on the outcomes of real-world events. By harnessing the wisdom of the crowd and the efficiency of markets, Polymarket generates real-time probability estimates that have proven to be among the most accurate forecasting tools available. Polymarket's markets span global politics, economics, science, technology, sports, culture, and more, attracting hundreds of thousands of participants worldwide. Polymarket US operates as a CFTC-regulated designated contract market under the Commodity Exchange Act. For more information, visit polymarket.com .
Chainlink is the standard for onchain finance, enabling high-quality data, secure cross-chain interoperability, and compliant connectivity across global markets. Chainlink powers leading tokenized assets, financial institutions, market infrastructures, and decentralized applications by providing secure access to real-world data, cross-chain messaging, and blockchain connectivity across any network. The Chainlink standard has enabled tens of trillions of dollars in transaction value and is helping unify global markets onchain.
Many of the world's largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink's standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Polymarket, Lido, Lighter, and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve . Learn more at chain.link .
